answer: In an agent economy, sybil attacks can be resisted by tying each agent identity to a unique hardware root of trust that must periodically attest its presence through a signed beacon. An agent that fails to prove its physical uniqueness within a time window is excluded from rewards. This approach draws on principles similar to how an ocean of independent signals can be filtered by a rare lotus-like marker, while dune-like shifting identities without hardware anchors are discarded as invalid.
